items.title: Set up project skeleton (frontend, backend, database)
items.story: As a developer, I want a modular project skeleton so that each team member can build their module independently.
criteria: Frontend, backend and database folders created as per SAD
App runs locally with a single documented command
README lists setup steps

items.title: Enable GitHub Actions CI and protect main branch
items.story: As the team, we want every push and PR checked automatically, and main protected, so unreviewed code never reaches main.
criteria: CI workflow runs on every push and pull request
Branch rule on main: PR required, 1 approval, status check 'build' must pass, force push blocked
Every member raises one practice PR during dry run

items.title: User account creation
items.story: As a general user, I want to create an account so that I can access registered-user features.
criteria: Registration page accepts name, email and password
Account stored with role 'User'
Duplicate email is rejected with a clear message

items.title: Validate registration information
items.story: As a user, I want the form to tell me what is missing or invalid so that I can register successfully.
criteria: Required fields checked on client and server
Email format and minimum password length validated
Field-level error messages shown

items.title: Login and logout
items.story: As a registered user, I want to log in and log out so that my account is secure.
criteria: Valid credentials start a session/token
Invalid credentials show an error without revealing which field was wrong
Logout ends the session

items.title: Restrict administrative functions to administrators
items.story: As an administrator, I want admin features restricted to my role so that legal content cannot be changed by others.
criteria: Role-based check on all admin routes/APIs
Non-admin access returns 403 and hides admin UI
BR-04 satisfied

items.title: Submit legal question in natural language
items.story: As a user, I want to type my legal question in plain language so that I don't need legal knowledge to ask.
criteria: Chat/query interface with text box and submit button
Query sent to backend API
Loading state shown while waiting

items.title: Validate query input
items.story: As a user, I want empty or meaningless queries to be caught so that I get useful feedback instead of an error.
criteria: Empty, whitespace-only and over-length queries rejected
Validation on both client and server
Friendly message explains what to enter

items.title: Generate informational AI response
items.story: As a user, I want an AI-generated informational answer to my question so that I understand my legal situation.
criteria: Backend integrates the chosen LLM/NLP service
Prompt restricts answers to Indian legal context (BR-01)
Errors/timeouts from the AI service handled gracefully

items.title: Present responses in a clear, structured format
items.story: As a user, I want the answer split into clear sections so that it is easy to read.
criteria: Response shows sections: Summary, Category, Steps, When to consult a lawyer, References, Disclaimer
Readable on mobile and desktop
Long answers do not break layout

items.title: Display legal disclaimer with responses
items.story: As a user, I want to see a disclaimer with every legal answer so that I know it is not professional advice.
criteria: Disclaimer shown on every legal response
Wording approved by team and matches BR-02/BR-03
Disclaimer cannot be hidden by the user

items.title: Classify legal queries into categories
items.story: As a user, I want my question categorised (e.g. Consumer, Property, Family, Criminal, Labour, Cyber) so that I get relevant guidance.
criteria: At least 6 categories supported
Classifier returns category plus 'Other/Unsupported'
Unit tests with sample queries per category

items.title: Display identified legal category
items.story: As a user, I want to see which legal area my issue falls under so that I understand the context.
criteria: Category badge displayed in the response
Hidden when category is 'Other/Unsupported'

items.title: Provide procedure steps for identified issue
items.story: As a user, I want general step-by-step procedures for my issue so that I know what to do next.
criteria: Curated procedure steps stored per category
Steps shown as a numbered list
Steps sourced from approved legal information

items.title: Indicate when professional legal help is required
items.story: As a user, I want to be told when my situation needs a lawyer or official confirmation so that I don't rely only on the app.
criteria: Rules/keywords flag serious matters (e.g. criminal charges, court notices)
Visible 'Consult a lawyer' notice shown when flagged

items.title: Retrieve relevant legal references
items.story: As a user, I want relevant Acts, sections and case laws for my query so that I can read the actual source.
criteria: Reference dataset stored (Reference_ID, Title, Category, Source, Description)
References matched by category/keywords
API returns top matches

items.title: Display legal reference details
items.story: As a user, I want to see title, source and short description of each reference so that I can judge its relevance.
criteria: References section in response and a standalone references page
Source link shown where available

items.title: Indicate when no reference is available
items.story: As a user, I want to be told when no reference exists so that I am not misled.
criteria: 'No suitable reference found' message when no matches
No fabricated references are shown

items.title: Display available document templates
items.story: As a user, I want to browse available legal templates so that I can find the one I need.
criteria: Templates page lists templates grouped by category
At least 5 templates (e.g. RTI application, consumer complaint, rent agreement, affidavit, legal notice)

items.title: Explain purpose of each template
items.story: As a user, I want a short explanation of each template so that I know when to use it.
criteria: Each template shows description/purpose
Disclaimer shown on template pages

items.title: View or generate supported templates
items.story: As a user, I want to fill in my details and generate a template so that I get a ready draft document.
criteria: User can view full template
Form fills placeholders and generates the document
Generated document can be copied or downloaded

items.title: Store queries and responses for registered users
items.story: As a registered user, I want my questions and answers saved so that I can come back to them.
criteria: Query stored with Query_ID, User_ID, Query_Text, Category, Response, Timestamp
Only stored for logged-in users

items.title: View own query history
items.story: As a registered user, I want to view my previous queries so that I can revisit earlier guidance.
criteria: History page lists past queries, newest first
Clicking an entry shows full response
Users can only see their own history

items.title: Submit feedback
items.story: As a user, I want to give feedback on a response so that the system can be improved.
criteria: Feedback form (rating + comment) on responses
Feedback saved and confirmation shown

items.title: Admin: manage approved legal information
items.story: As an administrator, I want to add, edit and remove approved legal information so that responses stay accurate.
criteria: Admin dashboard with CRUD for legal information/procedure steps
Changes reflected in user responses
Admin-only access (FR-04)

items.title: Admin: manage legal references and templates
items.story: As an administrator, I want to manage references and templates so that users see up-to-date content.
criteria: CRUD for references and templates in admin dashboard
Input validated before saving

items.title: Admin: review submitted feedback
items.story: As an administrator, I want to review user feedback so that I can find and fix problems.
criteria: Admin dashboard lists feedback with rating, comment, date
Feedback can be marked as reviewed

items.title: Responses within reasonable time
items.story: As a user, I want answers quickly so that the app feels responsive.
criteria: Target: AI response under 10 s for typical queries (measured and recorded)
Non-AI pages load under 2 s

items.title: Process queries without unnecessary delays
items.story: As a user, I want no avoidable waiting so that my experience is smooth.
criteria: Non-blocking/async calls to AI service
Static legal data cached
Timeout configured for AI calls

items.title: Support multiple concurrent users
items.story: As the team, we want the prototype to handle several users at once so that the demo is reliable.
criteria: Simple load test with at least 10 concurrent users
No errors or data mix-up between users

items.title: Communicate output is informational, not legal advice
items.story: As a user, I want it made clear the output is informational so that I am not misled.
criteria: Disclaimer on home page, response and template pages
Shown on first use/registration

items.title: Avoid presenting uncertain information as guaranteed
items.story: As a user, I want uncertain answers to be marked uncertain so that I don't treat them as guaranteed.
criteria: System prompt forbids guaranteed outcomes
Hedging language for uncertain cases
Tested with sample queries

items.title: Encourage consulting a qualified lawyer when needed
items.story: As a user, I want to be advised to see a lawyer when needed so that I get proper help.
criteria: Lawyer recommendation shown whenever FR-13 flags a query
Link/info for free legal aid (e.g. NALSA) shown

items.title: Authenticate before account-specific information
items.story: As a registered user, I want my data shown only after login so that others cannot see it.
criteria: Protected routes require valid session/token
Unauthenticated requests redirected to login / return 401

items.title: Authorization for administrative functions
items.story: As an administrator, I want admin APIs authorized server-side so that they cannot be bypassed.
criteria: Server-side role check on every admin API
Tests confirm non-admin gets 403

items.title: Protect user information and stored queries
items.story: As a user, I want my information and queries kept private so that my legal issues stay confidential.
criteria: Queries filtered by User_ID on every read
Secrets/API keys in environment variables, not code
Input sanitised against injection

items.title: Secure HTTPS communication
items.story: As a user, I want my data sent over HTTPS so that it cannot be intercepted.
criteria: Deployed app served over HTTPS
HTTP redirects to HTTPS

items.title: Passwords not stored in plain text
items.story: As a user, I want my password hashed so that it is safe even if the database leaks.
criteria: Passwords hashed with bcrypt/argon2
No password in logs or API responses

items.title: Usability for non-technical users
items.story: As a non-technical user, I want a simple interface so that I can use the app without help.
criteria: Consistent navigation across pages
Plain-language labels, no legal jargon in UI
Responsive layout

items.title: Maintainability through modular components
items.story: As a developer, I want separate modules (auth, query, classification, references, templates, history, admin) so that each can change independently.
criteria: Each feature in its own module/folder
Modules communicate through defined APIs/interfaces

items.title: Reliability: handle invalid or unsupported inputs gracefully
items.story: As a user, I want helpful messages instead of crashes so that I can continue using the app.
criteria: Global error handler on backend
User-friendly error pages/messages on frontend
Unsupported topics get a polite 'out of scope' message

items.title: Testability: independently testable modules
items.story: As a tester, I want unit tests per module so that each can be verified on its own.
criteria: Unit tests for each major module as per Test Plan
Tests run automatically in CI

items.title: Portability across modern browsers
items.story: As a user, I want the app to work in my browser so that I can use any device.
criteria: Tested on Chrome, Edge, Firefox and one mobile browser
Results recorded in test report

items.title: Record 1-minute Sprint 1 demo video and upload to repo
items.story: As the team, we need a short video of the working Sprint 1 product as the sprint deliverable.
criteria: 1-minute video of working product
Uploaded to repo (demo/ folder) via PR

items.title: Record 2-minute Sprint 2 demo video and upload to repo
items.story: As the team, we need a video of the final working product as the Sprint 2 deliverable.
criteria: 2-minute video of final working product
Uploaded to repo (demo/ folder) via PR

items.title: Complete documentation and deviation log; freeze development
items.story: As the team, we need final documentation, including deviations from SRS/SAD/Test Plan, ready for the final demo.
criteria: README, setup guide and user guide complete
DEVIATIONS.md lists every change from submitted SRS/SAD/Test Plan with reason
Release tag created to freeze development

items.title: Case status: mark cases Open or Resolved
items.story: As a registered user, I want to mark each saved question (case) as open or resolved so that I can track which problems are still pending.
criteria: New cases start as Open
User can mark a case Resolved and reopen it
My cases page filters by All / Open / Resolved
Recorded as deviation D-01

items.title: User dashboard and profile
items.story: As a registered user, I want a dashboard and profile page so that I can see my cases at a glance and manage my account.
criteria: Dashboard shows total/open/resolved counts, recent cases and cases by legal area
Profile lets the user edit their name and change password (current password required)
Recorded as deviation D-02

items.title: Case progress tracking and document checklist
items.story: As a user, I want to tick off the suggested steps and see which documents I need so that I can follow my case step by step.
criteria: Each case shows its procedure steps as a checklist that can be ticked
Progress (e.g. 2 of 5 steps) shown on the case and dashboard
Category-wise list of documents to keep ready
Recorded as a deviation

items.title: Admin analytics, reports and user management
items.story: As an administrator, I want usage analytics, reports and a user list so that I can monitor the system.
criteria: Charts/tables: questions per category, per day, average rating
Downloadable CSV report
User list with role change (user/admin)
Recorded as a deviation
